page.title: How it works
page.description: See how TailorTales turns a name, an age and a single question into a personalized, illustrated children's book in three simple steps.

hero.heading: Three <highlight>small steps</highlight>, one <highlight>lasting tale</highlight>.
hero.subheading: No accounts to configure, no prompts to engineer. You answer three questions and the workshop does the rest.

lightAName.title: Light a name
lightAName.body: Tell us who the story is for — a first name, an age, and two or three things they love right now. Dinosaurs, puddles, their dog. We use that to anchor the tale in their world, not a generic one.
lightAName.detail3: You can save profiles for next time

whisperAWhy.title: Whisper a why
whisperAWhy.body: Pick the question or theme that's been on their mind lately. Why is the sky dark? Where do lost things go? Choose from our curated list or type your own. The tale is built around that spark, not around a generic plot.
whisperAWhy.detail2: Or write your own in plain words

carryItHome.title: Carry it home
carryItHome.body: In a few minutes, a printable PDF lands in your library. Five to twenty pages — the length fits the age. A picture book for four-year-olds, a longer comic for eight-year-olds. Theirs to keep, re-read, and print.
carryItHome.detail3: Print at home or at any copy shop

page.title: Pricing
page.description: Simple plans for personalized AI storybooks. Start free with your first chapter — no card required. Upgrade anytime for more tales and pages.

hero.eyebrow: Pay per tale or join the Story Hour
hero.heading: Priced like a <highlight>small workshop</highlight>.
hero.subheading: Tales are sold by the page, or in a small monthly bundle. No tricks, no per-book add-ons, no hidden seats. Cancel any time — your shelf stays yours.

plans.creditNote: Page credits: 1 book page = 1 credit · 1 comic page = 2 credits.

cancelAnyTime.question: Can I cancel any time?
cancelAnyTime.answer: Yes — at the click of a button. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for, and your finished stories stay in your library.

unusedCredits.question: What if I don't use my credits?
unusedCredits.answer: Unused credits expire at the end of each billing month — your full allowance returns with every new cycle.

contentSafety.question: Is the content safe for my child?
contentSafety.answer: Every tale is filtered through layered text and image moderation before delivery. We are strict — child-friendly only.

childData.question: Do you keep my child's data?
childData.answer: Only what's needed to make the tales. Names and photos never leave your account. Full export and deletion any time.

giftingTale.question: Can I gift a tale?
giftingTale.answer: Yes. Both paid plans let you share finished tales — perfect for nieces, nephews, and small friends.

hero.heading: Get <highlight>in touch</highlight>.
hero.subheading: A question, a suggestion, or just a hello — we read every message.

section.heading: Drop us a line
section.body: We're a small team, so replies may take a day or two. We always write back.

form.successBody: We read every one. We'll write back soon.

page.title: Privacy
page.description: How TailorTales collects, uses and protects your and your child's data. Read our privacy commitments and your rights.

hero.heading: Your family's <highlight>data</highlight> is <highlight>yours</highlight>.
hero.subheading: Short version: we collect only what we need to make the tales, we never sell it, and you can delete everything at any time.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: We collect your email address, the first name and age of each child profile you create, and the tale preferences you choose (themes, art style, format). We also collect standard server logs (IP address, browser type) for security and debugging. Nothing else.

howWeUseIt.title: How we use it
howWeUseIt.body: Your child's name and age are used only to personalise the tale you requested — they are never used for advertising, profiling, or shared with third parties. Your email is used to deliver tales and, if you opt in, to send occasional updates about new features. You can unsubscribe at any time.

whoWeShareWith.title: Who we share it with
whoWeShareWith.body: We use a small number of trusted sub-processors to operate the service: a cloud hosting provider, a payment processor (for paid plans), and an AI image generation service. Each receives only the minimum data needed. We do not sell, rent, or trade your data. Ever.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body: You can export all your data or delete your account at any time from Account → Privacy. Deletion is permanent and processed within 30 days. If you have a question or concern, email us at hello@tailortales.app and we will respond within 5 business days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use one first-party session cookie to keep you signed in, and one cookie to remember your preferences (language, theme). We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies.

login.heading: Step back into the workshop.
login.subheading: Sign in to find your library, your children's profiles, and any tales you began but didn't finish.
login.legal: By continuing you agree to our terms and privacy policy. We will never sell your child's data. We promise.

whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: Your Google account basics (name, email, avatar), the child profiles you create (name, birthdate, interests), character descriptions, and the stories we generate for you. We never ask for, or store, payment card details.

whyWeProcessIt.title: Why we process it
whyWeProcessIt.body: Solely to create and deliver your personalized stories, run your subscription, and notify you when tales are ready. No advertising, no profiling, no selling data.

whoHelpUs.title: Who helps us (sub-processors)
whoHelpUs.body: Paddle (payments & billing), OpenRouter (story text and illustration generation), Resend (email delivery), and our cloud storage provider (generated PDFs and images). Each receives only what their job requires.

howLongWeKeepIt.title: How long we keep it
howLongWeKeepIt.body: Your account data stays while the account exists. Generated story files follow your plan's retention period — Free Chapter PDFs and images are removed 30 days after creation; paid-tier stories are kept while you subscribe.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body: Export everything we hold about you as JSON below, or delete your account — including every generated file — at any time. Questions? Reach us via the contact page.
